#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#define LL long long
using namespace std;

int digitCount(LL x) {
    int cnt = 0;
    while (x) {
        x /= 10;
        cnt++;
    }
    return cnt;
}

LL maxRepunit(LL x) {
    int d = digitCount(x);
    LL cur = 0, mul = 1;
    for (int i = 0; i < d; i++) {
        cur += mul;
        mul *= 10;
    }
    if (cur <= x) return cur;
    return (cur - 1) / 10;
}

LL solve(LL x) {
    if (x <= 6) return x;
    if (x <= 11) return 13 - x;
    LL low = maxRepunit(x);
    LL high = low * 10 + 1;
    if (x % low == 0) {
        if (x <= high / 2 + low)
            return digitCount(low) * x / low;
        else
            return digitCount(high) + solve(high - x);
    } else {
        LL base = (x / low) * low;
        LL res = solve(base) + solve(x - base);
        if (x > high / 2)
            res = min(res, digitCount(high) + solve(high - x));
        return res;
    }
}

int main() {
    LL n;
    cin >> n;
    cout << solve(n) << endl;
    return 0;
}
